## Full Description

GitHub Repo Beautifier is a reusable Hermes skill that transforms any GitHub repository README into a premium, branded product page. It combines visual asset generation (SVG), intentional badge orchestration, structured copywriting, and GitHub rendering verification.

Unlike template-based README generators that force the same structure onto every project, this skill:
1. Reads the actual project structure and existing README
2. Determines the project type (web app, library, CLI tool, data pipeline, visualization)
3. Chooses between two formats based on needs and asset availability
4. Generates custom visual assets (logo mark, hero banner, architecture diagram)
5. Writes product-oriented copy with concrete numbers and anti-AI-slop rules
6. Structures sections for scanability and hierarchy
7. Verifies GitHub rendering before declaring done

## Two Supported Formats

### Format A: Hero Banner Style
For projects with visual identity — premium tools, open-source products, portfolio pieces.

Elements:
- Centered logo mark (SVG, 92×92, dark gradient)
- for-the-badge shields: product info (status, type, license) + tech stack with logos
- Inline navigation anchors linking to major sections
- Wide SVG hero banner (1200×400, dark-mode friendly)
- Framing block with expectation-setting callout
- 14-section structure with emoji-led headings
- Architecture/workflow diagram (SVG)
- Author footer with cross-promotion links

Real examples using this format:
- hermes-optimizer (provider-agnostic Hermes optimization skill)
- rag-shchedrovitsky (RAG bot for Shchedrovitsky's 335 works)

### Format B: Fast ASCII Style
For quick wins without custom graphics — scripts, data pipelines, CLI tools, rapid prototypes.

Elements:
- ASCII banner (≤3 lines, project name or tagline)
- flat-square shields (GitHub, status, stack, license)
- Italic pitch block (15 words max)
- Emoji tree structure (📁 project/ ├── 📖 README.md ← start here)
- Status table (✅ works, 🟡 partial, ❌ broken, 📦 archive, 💡 concept)
- Author footer with links

Real example:
- creative-system (autoposting system, FastAPI + SQLite)

## 14-Section Reference Structure

1. Hero Block — centered: logo, badges, pitch, nav, banner
2. Framing Block — > blockquote with expectation-setting, [!NOTE] callout
3. Concept (💡) — why exists, what makes it different, "X does Y"
4. Features (✨) — dense features table, 2 columns max
5. Quick Start (🚀) — one-command install/run, option variants in <details>
6. Core Mechanism — architecture, lanes, pipeline, how it works
7. Package/Structure — what files matter, with emoji tree
8. At a Glance (🧠) — signal/value summary table
9. Tech Stack (🏗️) — layer/technology table
10. Workflow (🧭) — ASCII flow or SVG diagram
11. What It Improves — benefit table, area → typical improvement
12. Example Output — sample response/request shape
13. Quality Checks (🛡️) — what is verified, tested, linted
14. Roadmap (🗺️) — checklist with ✅ (done) and 🟡 (planned)
15. Contributing (🤝) — how to contribute, good contribution areas
16. License (📄) — license text + author footer with cross-promo

## Visual Asset Specs

| Asset | Format | Dimensions | Colors | Purpose |
|-------|--------|------------|--------|---------|
| Logo mark | SVG | 92×92 | Dark bg (#0f0f1a → #1a1a2e), accent gradient | Identity above H1 |
| Hero banner | SVG | 1200×400 | Same dark bg, accent line at top, tech tags | Top visual |
| Architecture flow | SVG | 1000×280 | Box-and-arrow with colored borders | System diagram |
| Social preview | PNG | 1280×640 | Same dark theme, centered title | GitHub Settings → Social preview |

Shield Rules:
- Product info: for-the-badge, no logos (status, type, license)
- Tech stack: for-the-badge WITH logos (Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, etc.)
- Max 10 badges total
- Badge colors: success (green), blue (info), purple (type), lightgrey (license)

## Anti-Slop Copy Rules

Banned phrases:
- «Как вы можете видеть»
- «Важно отметить»
- «Стоит упомянуть»
- «Не забудьте»
- «Как уже говорилось»
- «Безусловно»

Rotation bank (opening phrases):
- «Готово»
- «Сделано»
- «Запушено»
- «В продакшене»
- «Финализировано»
- «Оформлено»

Status emoji variety:
- Don't use ✅ more than 3 times in a row
- Rotate: 🟢 📦 🚀 🎯 ✅

Numbers rule: always use concrete numbers, never «много», «несколько», «ряд»

## Installation

```bash
hermes skills install https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AzamatSafarov/github-repo-beautifier/main/SKILL.md -y
```

Usage:
```text
/skill github-repo-beautifier
Make my repo look premium.
```
